summary: Rechecked all 47 layers, 234 targets and 157 citation occurrences across the five roadmaps. One medium library-coverage finding: the exceptional discriminant -3 unit computation already exists in Mathlib. The remaining checks did not establish an additional error; no arithmetic endpoint is promoted to built.
checked: Read the accepted AUDIT-25 result and REV-AUDIT-25 report, all five full roadmap documents and their stage extracts. Reconciled all 47 layers and 234 target records with the audit brief: four partly built, 41 not built, two process; target labels 192 absent, 34 partial, seven mathlib, one both. The audit author and original reviewer are different from this worker.

Read all 157 cited declaration occurrences, with 126 distinct declarations, at Mathlib 082e2d37e8b0463410cdb532e111cd43d5a66174 and Tau Ceti f790474821cf4256814db967cb154e7af3d0c369. Checked full multiline statements, structure fields, surrounding section hypotheses and necessary definition bodies. Verified all 95 cited files against their pinned Git blob hashes; verified four additional evidence files, 99 files total. Cited files contain no sorry/admit outside comments, and cited declarations are not axioms. No Lean compilation was performed.

Rechecked the 226 absent/partial targets using the declaration index first and pinned Lean files second, in 22 topic groups plus focused follow-ups: canonical heights and regular models; intersections, CM and Shimura curves; toric periods and theta formulas; elliptic local/Kummer machinery; orders and units; Euler systems, descent and Chebotarev; cohomological transfers; completed group algebras and module structure; cyclotomic arithmetic and class field theory; Iwasawa main conjectures and p-adic L-functions; K-theory, eta and modular symbols; locally analytic spaces, measures, logarithms, character spaces and Fredholm families. Search misses are bounded evidence, not proofs of nonexistence.

Read all 82 duplicate-lead entries and the complete relevant document sections for their 67 distinct owner stages. Checked current ownership against the available stage links, accepted restructuring context and reviewed coverage. Deliberate imports, source-specific adapters and higher-weight analogues were not treated as duplicate proofs merely because targets overlap.

Recomputed the elliptic normalization from canonicalHeight, neronTatePairing and its self-pairing, and the regulator definition; compared Silverman AEC VIII.9 pp.248–253 and Cremona Algorithms §3.4 pp.71–72. The audit correctly reports half the limiting x-height and half the Silverman/Cremona pairing over Q, hence a factor 2^(-r) for the regulator.

Rechecked the general coefficient hypotheses on explicitCor1, explicitInfRes_exact and explicitCup11. They allow general topological additive coefficients under their continuity hypotheses; the audit’s discrete-coefficient descriptions are valid specializations, not evidence that compact derived Iwasawa theory is available. Did not promote this possible wording improvement to an error finding.

Challenged the distribution and Iwasawa absence claims with LogOneAdd, IsProP, abstract measure products/pushforwards, continuousAddCharEquiv, Weierstrass preparation, Riesz theory and the classical Selmer square-class carriers. Their actual hypotheses and carriers do not furnish the missing arithmetic towers, p-adic convergence theorem, locally analytic distribution spaces or cohomological elliptic Selmer package.
Refreshed guarded inputs against main ae16efd59f8727140b163dd6a3318e0da593cd2a: no input file changed from the acquired snapshot. Only the two authorized red-team deliverables are submitted.

findings.claim: The blanket assertion that there is no computation of the unit groups of imaginary quadratic orders misses Mathlib’s explicit computation for the maximal order of Q(zeta_3), the discriminant -3 exception. The full Heegner/CM treatment of exceptional discriminants is still absent.
findings.evidence: At Mathlib 082e2d37e8b0463410cdb532e111cd43d5a66174, IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.Three.Units.mem, https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/082e2d37e8b0463410cdb532e111cd43d5a66174/Mathlib/NumberTheory/NumberField/Cyclotomic/Three.lean#L34-L78, takes a field K with NumberField K and IsCyclotomicExtension {3} Q K, a primitive third root zeta and u : (O K)^units, and proves u belongs to [1, -1, eta, -eta, eta^2, -eta^2], with eta the integral unit induced by zeta. The declaration index locates it at line 51; its full statement, local notation and proof were read at the pin. Its carrier is the actual units of the ring of integers, not an abstract torsion group or a hypothetical order. The same file’s eq_one_or_neg_one_of_unit_of_congruent at lines 97–103 supplies a further congruence refinement. The already cited general cyclotomic discriminant formula specializes at n=3 to -3; no unproved CM theorem is needed to identify this special case. The source file’s Git blob is 05905ab52395a37da0507069d1dba3f1ebd96773.
findings.fix: Keep the full exceptional-discriminant Heegner target marked absent, but replace its blanket absence note by: Mathlib explicitly computes the units of the maximal order of Q(zeta_3); general quadratic-order unit computations, the other exceptional case and the no-division CM/Heegner formulas have not been supplied by this evidence. Add IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.Three.Units.mem at Three.lean:51 with fit special case, retaining NumberField.Units.torsion as related evidence. Do not mark the whole layer built or infer an arbitrary-conductor order result from this maximal-order theorem.
